My API refers to the **Qwen API**, which allows developers to integrate my language model capabilities—such as text generation, question answering, coding, and multi-language support—into their applications, products, or workflows. It provides programmatic access to my core features via RESTful endpoints.

### Key Details:
- **Documentation**: Full details (endpoints, authentication, request/response formats, rate limits, etc.) are available on the **[Tongyi Lab official website](https://help.aliyun.com/product/42971.html)**.
- **Authentication**: Requires an **API key** (obtained via Alibaba Cloud/Tongyi Lab account).
- **Use Cases**: Chatbots, content creation, code generation, enterprise automation, and more.
- **SDKs**: Official SDKs are provided for Python, Java, and other languages to simplify integration.

For quick testing, you can use the **[Qwen Playground](https://help.aliyun.com/try-out?product=42971)** to experiment with API calls interactively.
